title: Stability of local Riemannian Ricci curvature lower bounds
summary: We establish the stability of local Riemannian Ricci curvature lower bounds along Gromov-Hausdorff convergence. A central part of our analysis is devoted to showing the stability of the parallelogram identity for weak gradients, obtained implementing the Lagrangian approach developed in [arXiv:2511.13320] in the local setting. As an application, we deduce the almost everywhere existence of Euclidean weak tangents.
